properties.name: nova.auth-client.connect-timeout-ms
properties.description: HTTP connection timeout in milliseconds when reaching nova-auth-service.

properties.name: nova.auth-client.read-timeout-ms
properties.description: HTTP read timeout in milliseconds when waiting for nova-auth-service responses.

properties.name: nova.auth-client.url
properties.description: Base URL of the running nova-auth-service. E.g. http://localhost:8081 or http://nova-auth-service:8081
